observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tamang inihihiwalay ang tatlong uri ng detalye; walang diagnosis o husga; may tiyak na rekord o taong lalapitan para beripikahin.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Correctly separates all three kinds of detail, adds no diagnosis or judgment, and names a specific record or person for verification.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Isinusulat na tiyak ang hula o opinyon ng kapitbahay.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Records a guess or the neighbor’s opinion as established fact.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang inihihiwalay ang tatlong uri ng detalye; walang diagnosis o husga; may tiyak na rekord o taong lalapitan para beripikahin. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correctly separates all three kinds of detail, adds no diagnosis or judgment, and names a specific record or person for verification. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakikilala ang sinabi at nakita ngunit walang plano sa kulang; ipatukoy ang rekord o health team member na makatutulong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Distinguishes reports and observations but gives no verification plan; ask for the relevant record or health team member.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isinusulat na tiyak ang hula o opinyon ng kapitbahay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Records a guess or the neighbor’s opinion as established fact.
